market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished 2nd in each of the last two Premier League seasons (2022-23 and 2023-24) and are projected to be strong title contenders again in 2025-26 under a stable manager and with a deep squad.  A 16.5% implied probability for exactly 2nd appears too low given their consistency and the likelihood that they will be among the top two or three teams; I estimate the true chance around 23%.
evidence_points: Back-to-back 2nd-place finishes in 2022-23 and 2023-24 show a reliable floor of performance.
Squad core (Saka, Ødegaard, Rice, Saliba) is young and under long contracts; financial strength supports further investment.
No clear reason to expect a significant drop-off by 2025-26; Manchester City may face uncertainty, potentially boosting Arsenal's relative standing.
sources_consulted: Club squad and contract information up to early 2025
